message.reasoning: No abstract present — deliverable requires ~150-word abstract. Also no figures. Word count seems fine. VW scandal: "electric vehicles" and "crash-safety tests" — factual errors (diesel, emissions tests). 1% of 5,000 = 50, not 500 — math error. Recommendation contradicts conclusion? Conclusion says don't ship; recommendation says accept contract but delay — somewhat coherent but item 1 "accept the contract" conflicts slightly. Missing abstract, missing discussion of "how to decide when to ship" partially addressed. No visual elements. References mostly relevant but [1] weak, [3] no URL. Marks: C1: several issues, stakeholders yes, org context yes → 8. C2: arguments both sides, conclusion for stakeholders somewhat → 8. C3: logical, compelling, conclusion supported → 8. C4: references + quantitative (1% calc, though wrong) + case studies → 8. C5: fluent but typos ("DICUSSION", "erosion ofprofessional"), no abstract, no visuals, references inconsistent → 6.
